## alice-dms-image-description-backfill

Retries the AI vision description for Weaviate "Image" objects where
extraction_failed = true (e.g. after an OLLAMA_URL outage).

**Triggers**:
- `Schedule Trigger: 23:30` — daily, window limit 2h15min (8100s)
- `Schedule Trigger: 06:00` — daily, window limit 1h45min (6300s)
- `Webhook: POST /image-description-backfill` — ad-hoc test runs, optional
  `max_runtime_seconds` override in body/query (same override pattern as PROJ-92)

**Auto-continue (PROJ-96)**: fetches up to 50 images per batch (LIMIT unchanged).
If time remains in the window (>= 5min buffer) and images with extraction_failed=true
remain, the workflow re-invokes itself (Execute Workflow, waitForSubWorkflow=true),
passing the original window_start + limit forward so the time check stays consistent
across the whole self-invocation chain.

**Time limit check**: between loop iterations (not mid Ollama-call/PATCH), analog
PROJ-94 — the in-flight image always finishes before the loop is left.

**Overlap lock**: `alice:dms:image-description-backfill:lock:run` (Redis) — first
invocation of a window chain acquires fail-closed (skip run if already locked by
another chain); every self-invocation renews the same lock fail-open (Redis hiccup
must not abort an already-running chain — TTL is the fallback safety net).

**Processes**: Weaviate collection "Image" only, filter extraction_failed = true
**Leaves untouched**: weaviate_uuid, thumbnail_path, additionalPaths, EXIF and geocoding fields
**Progress**: logged as { processed, updated, still_failed, remaining }
**Safe to re-run**: extraction_failed = true filter automatically excludes already-fixed images
